story.title: Fan Files $10 Million Lawsuit Against Yankees After Bat Injury
story.summary: A New Jersey woman is suing the New York Yankees for $10 million, claiming she suffered a brain injury when a baseball bat flew into the stands and struck her in the head. The incident allegedly occurred despite the presence of protective netting.

related_stories.title: Trump Plans Supreme Court Appeal After Court Halts White House Ballroom Construction
related_stories.summary: A federal appeals court has blocked President Trump's $400 million ballroom construction project at the White House, ruling that he cannot proceed without congressional approval. The court's decision affirms a lower court ruling and allows only below-ground construction to continue. Trump has announced his intention to appeal the ruling to the Supreme Court, calling it unjust.

related_stories.title: Trump Resumes Efforts to Dismiss Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook
related_stories.summary: Donald Trump is renewing his attempts to fire Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook after the US Supreme Court previously blocked his efforts. The administration is moving forward with the dismissal despite Cook's denial of mortgage fraud allegations that prompted the initial attempt to terminate her position.

related_stories.title: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan Establish Mutual Defense Pact
related_stories.summary: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan have signed a mutual defense agreement, stating that an armed attack on any one of the three nations will be considered an attack on all. The pact aims to reshape the security dynamics in the region, particularly in light of ongoing conflicts. The agreement was formalized during a meeting in Mecca, although it does not specify the obligations for military action in defense of one another.
